what: One live decision issued from the web console (POST /api/decide, quick gate, one noul) and recorded by the CLI's shared ledger writer with which="web". The figures in CHANGELOG.md under 0.13.0 'Measured live' are read from this row.

key.name: JEV_API_KEY
key.note: the fingerprint is the non-secret value /api/doctor shows; no key material is stored here

observed_in_page.note: the ledger row does not store the distribution; this is what the page rendered

cost_note: the vendor response carries no cost field; cost_usd is computed from the published $0.042/Mtok input rate
reproduce: python -m jevskill web --no-open; open http://127.0.0.1:8765; paste a three-line diff as state and run the quick gate with the intent below. Tokens and cost are deterministic for the same state and question; latency varies per call.

ledger_row.intent: Does the diff at `state` change a public function signature?
